loss_definition.reasoning: Retain all assistant text and reconstructedreasoning; plain LFTemplate does not remove<think>content
loss_definition.export: One final full conversation per main/continuation/summarization file, using pinned Harbor extraction; never all cumulative prefixes. Skip copied-only files with no new agent generation, record this. Merge adjacent user messages exactly as10K preprocessing.
loss_definition.copied_context: Keep copied context required by eachSFT example and reportcopied assistant counts; all-assistant supervision can repeat such context acrossrows. Do not secretlymask it toforceunique-token weighting.
loss_definition.estimator: For each half H, g_H = -sum_i(score_i-mean_H score)*sum_s grad CE_sum(s) / T_H; official score retained, no binarization, no reward standard-deviation normalization.
loss_definition.interpretation: Reward-weighted SFT-loss gradient at base, not an unbiased full-rollout policygradient: SFT encoding contains allhistoricalreasoning and maytruncate at32K whereas originalinference history canomitreasoning/resetat summaries.

limitations: Adaptive easy-task selection from a disclosed8-sample pilot; all screening outcomes retained.
Formal32rollouts use disjoint seeds and do not include screening data.
Threepartitions share samples, not independent replications.
Constant score half gives zero gradient and undefined cosine.
Score weighted originalSFT loss, not exact on-policy gradient; retain reasoning, truncation, and copied contexts.
No optimizer update; no claim of improved success from cosine alone.
Score-based weighting supersedes binary mapping at explicit user request, before any formal sample or gradient computation.
